en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.title: Remote Workspace
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.keywords: remote ssh openssh host server reconnect reconnection connection wsl
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.sshProgramHelp: The OpenSSH client started to reach a host. Automatic uses the ssh found on PATH. WSL distributions are reached without SSH and do not use it.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.programMissing: {path} does not exist. Connecting fails until it is back or the program is set to Automatic.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.programNotExecuta: {path} is not an executable file. Connecting fails until it is or the program is set to Automatic.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.sshConfigHelp: Host aliases, ports, keys and jump hosts come from this file. Lithe reads it and never writes it.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.reconnectLimitHel: After a connection is lost, Lithe tries again within this time, waiting 1, 2, 4… seconds and at most 29 seconds between attempts. With Don't Reconnect the workspace stays disconnected until you reconnect it.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.storageHelp: Only the values you change are kept, in this machine's preference folder. Nothing is written to a host.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.storageNone: Created when you change a value
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.closeProgramsHelp: What happens to the terminals and processes still running on the host when you close a remote workspace or its window, or quit Lithe. Kept programs are listed the next time you connect to the same host, where you can end them. Remember my choice in the close question changes this too.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.idleTimeoutHelp: After a connection is lost, the host keeps its session and programs this long, so reconnecting picks them up; then it ends them. A session whose programs you kept on the host does not time out. The remote server sets this, so it cannot be changed.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.damaged: {path} cannot be read. Fix or delete the file; until then no host is connected with it.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.conflict: The preference file changed meanwhile and was read again. Apply your change again.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.unavailable: There is no preference folder to keep these settings in.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.failed: The remote workspace settings could not be read or saved: {reason}
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgramRel: The SSH program must be an absolute path.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgramMis: The chosen SSH program does not exist.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgramNot: The chosen SSH program is not an executable file.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgram: The SSH program path cannot be used.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedLimit: The reconnect time must be between 0 and 3600 seconds.
en-US.desktop.remote.preferences.damaged: The remote workspace settings file is damaged, so the host was not connected. Open Settings › Tools › Remote Workspace to see it.
en-US.desktop.remoteSettings.reverseForwarding: Lets the Ports window forward a port on the host's loopback address back to this computer. Every user of the host can connect to such a port, so it is off by default; each rule is still confirmed before it starts.

zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.title: 远程工作区
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.keywords: 远程 主机 服务器 重连 断线 连接 remote ssh openssh wsl
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.sshProgramHelp: 连接主机时启动的 OpenSSH 客户端。自动时使用 PATH 中找到的 ssh。WSL 发行版不经过 SSH，不受影响。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.programMissing: 找不到 {path}。在它恢复或改回自动之前，连接会失败。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.programNotExecuta: {path} 不是可执行文件。在修好或改回自动之前，连接会失败。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.sshConfigHelp: 主机别名、端口、密钥和跳板机都从这个文件读取。Lithe 只读取，不会写入。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.reconnectLimitHel: 连接断开后，在这段时间内自动重试，间隔依次为 1、2、4…秒，最长 29 秒。选“不自动重连”时，工作区保持断开，直到你手动重连。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.storageHelp: 只保存你改过的值，放在本机的偏好设置目录中，不会写到主机上。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.closeProgramsHelp: 关闭远程工作区、它的窗口或退出 Lithe 时，主机上仍在运行的终端和进程怎么处理。保留在远端的进程，下次连接同一主机时会列出来，可以再结束。关闭时勾选“记住我的选择”也会改这里。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.idleTimeoutHelp: 连接断开后，主机在这段时间内保留会话和其中的进程，期间重连会接回它们，超时后结束。选择保留在远端的会话不会超时。这个时长由远端服务决定，不能修改。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.damaged: 无法读取 {path}。请修正或删除这个文件；修好之前不会用它连接主机。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.conflict: 设置文件在此期间被改过，已重新读取。请再次应用你的修改。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.unavailable: 没有可以保存这些设置的偏好设置目录。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.failed: 无法读取或保存远程工作区设置：{reason}
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgramRel: SSH 程序必须是绝对路径。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgramMis: 找不到选择的 SSH 程序。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgramNot: 选择的 SSH 程序不是可执行文件。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedProgram: 这个 SSH 程序路径不能使用。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.refusedLimit: 自动重连时长必须在 0 到 3600 秒之间。
zh-CN.desktop.remote.preferences.damaged: 远程工作区设置文件已损坏，因此没有连接主机。请在 设置 › 工具 › 远程工作区 中查看。
zh-CN.desktop.remoteSettings.reverseForwarding: 允许在端口窗口中把主机回环地址上的端口转发回本机。主机上的所有用户都能连接这样的端口，因此默认不允许；每条规则开始前仍会确认。
